character: tall spotted giraffe in a loose grey tie at a white mailbox on a post; the neck sweeps like a crane arm, forelegs splay to the ground; two thirds of frame height in every window
cast: one darker giraffe without a tie; it works large at the lens, never still, never talks
motion_rule: the tied giraffe is the subject of every window, the other adds to his move; action never stops in the silent windows; no window ends in a pose; shot size never repeats
props: a paper bill roll printed with big dark columns of digits down its length; the mailbox lid claps
environment: noon savanna, pale sand, acacia, bleached sky, hard white sun; sand fills the lower half

audio.delivery: male voice, bored deadpan, 4.4 syllables per second inside a line, never drawn out, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: налоги is na-LO-gi; наклоняться is na-klo-NYAT-sa
audio.pacing: each line fills its own window at full speed; the four windows without a line are SILENT, not slowed speech; nothing said after 7.9
audio.lip_sync: jaw and lips shape every syllable, mouth shut in the silent beats, never a voice-over

timeline.a: his head drops from the top of the frame, the lid claps open and the digit roll bursts into the lens
timeline.c: macro, ripped up with his head

timeline.a: his tongue hooks the roll out and it falls open down his whole neck, digits running past the lens
the other shoves its muzzle into the paper and drags it sideways, the sheet slapping the lens
he throws his head up, the paper snapping straight along the neck, the other hanging off the end
the other puffs its belly out at the lens and struts past on stiff legs
he bats the roll and it swings over the post, digits blurring
he pinches the sheet in his lips and it rips down the middle, the other catching the torn half at the lens
timeline.c: macro on the tear, drifts out

timeline.a: his forelegs slide wider apart, sand kicking into the lens
he shakes the paper down its whole length, the other jumping through it
the roll slaps flat on the sand, dust bursting into the lens
his neck starts folding down, the horizon rolling up the frame with it
he grinds his muzzle along the ground, the other at the lens pressing his head lower
he rolls the sheet into a scroll and swallows it, the lump travelling the full length of his neck
the lid blows open and a paper avalanche pours over both, digits filling the frame
only his head is above the drift, a strip of digits over his eyes, he chews it flat

must_appear: big dark digits down the whole roll, readable; four silent beats inside the speech with the action still running; the belly puff; the neck folded to the sand; the avalanche burying him
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, dusk, dim light, a blank paper roll, letters or words on the paper, Cyrillic writing, static camera, cuts, a talking head, a still neck, the second giraffe frozen or out of frame, subtitles, watermark, English speech, voice-over, drawn-out vowels, speech in the silent beats, any word after 7.9, deformed anatomy
